## Researcher, DFKI Berlin · PhD Student, TU Berlin

# Steffen Castle

I study how language models use information internally — and how those internal signals can be turned into tools: detecting hallucinations in retrieval-augmented generation, monitoring drift, and controlling generation.

## Research story

::: {.timeline}
::: {.timeline-item}
[2019–2020]{.timeline-year}

**Improving neural network explanations**  
Master's research at DFKI on Pattern-Guided Attribution and Pattern-Guided Integrated Gradients.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2020–2022]{.timeline-year}

**PLASS — information extraction for supply-chain risk**  
Relation extraction and uncertainty quantification for monitoring supply-chain risks in multilingual news (BMWi, with Siemens). Produced *Detecting Covariate Drift with Explanations* (2021): explanation signals as operational tools for detecting covariate shift.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2023]{.timeline-year}

**PhD: machine-internal uses of explainability**  
Thesis topic *Beyond Human Interaction: Alternative Applications for Explanations*. Rather than producing explanations for people to read, the thesis asks whether attribution signals can serve AI systems directly: detecting distribution shift, improving retrieval, and verifying factuality.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2023–2024]{.timeline-year}

**Data4Transparency — search over leaked documents for investigative journalists**  
Few-shot joint named-entity recognition and relation extraction to surface entities and relationships in large document dumps, with the Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (OCCRP).
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2024]{.timeline-year}

**Green-AI Hub — automated product carbon footprint estimation**  
LLM-based entity linking to map manufactured components to environmental impact databases for SMEs (Green-AI Hub Mittelstand, BMUV). Published at the Ecology & Environment NLP workshop, 2025.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2024–2025]{.timeline-year}

**Explaining embedding similarity for retrieval**  
Adapting attribution methods (ALTI, Integrated Gradients) to pairwise embedding similarity, and using token-level attributions to rerank retrieved documents for RAG.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2025–present]{.timeline-year}

**GenKI4Media — trustworthy generative AI for the media sector**  
Methods for the transparency, traceability, and accuracy of AI-generated editorial content (BMFTR, with dpa and Deutsche Welle). Two strands: detecting unsupported RAG answers from model internals (extended abstract at BlackboxNLP 2026, full paper forthcoming), and DELTA, training-free character-length control for masked diffusion LMs (EMNLP 2026).
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2026]{.timeline-year}

**XPO (Software Campus) — explainability-guided prompt repair**  
Project lead for a 12-month Software Campus project with Celonis on explainability-guided prompt optimization and repair for reliable agentic workflows.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
[2026]{.timeline-year}

**GUARDRAIL — reliability-aware knowledge graphs**  
Franco-German AI for Science project on propagating source-reliability signals from KG construction through retrieval, claim verification, and abstention.
:::
:::
